column1: # The argument list each documented collection method is sent in
# class<TAB>method<TAB>arguments, where `--` is a send with none.
# A LIST IS ONLY REAL IF THE ORACLE ANSWERS rc 0 TO IT. Any row the
# oracle refuses is a harness failure for that row and not a data point;
# collection_arity.rs makes that a test failure. Without the rule the
# instrument reads green having sent nothing that could work.
# `other` is a second collection of the receiver's own class, built by
# the probe; the receiver itself is corpus/collection-receivers.tsv.
